applies_to: coreav extract-subtitles and coreav chapters through scripts/text_check.py, ffprobe and ffmpeg 7.0.2, MediaInfo 26.10

conditions.output: a cue that ends at 100 hours or later (a timestamp with three or more hour digits) and at least one that ends before
conditions.MediaInfo: WebVTT, with the event count, first start and last end of the cues that end before 100 hours

entries.basis: W3C WebVTT 4.5 (hours are two or more digits); docs/design/text.md choice 11

conditions.rewrite: CoreAV's cue text with those three references replaced by &, < and >

entries.basis: W3C WebVTT 4.2.2 (cue text spans contain no & or <; a cue payload never contains -->); docs/design/text.md choice 8

conditions.coreav summary: styl, hlit, hclr, krok or blnk boxes counted
conditions.rewrite: ffmpeg's cue text without those tags and their end tags

entries.basis: issue #40 and docs/design/text.md choice 9 (styling is dropped and reported); 3GPP TS 26.245 5.17.1

conditions.source: a sample whose text starts with spaces (3GPP timed text or QuickTime text, with or without style records)
conditions.cues: same count; CoreAV's text starts with spaces that ffmpeg's lacks and is otherwise equal; the cue, spaces included, is one of the source's samples: its exact times from the sample tables and edit list, and its text written as CoreAV writes cue text
conditions.rewrite: CoreAV's cue text without those leading spaces

entries.basis: 3GPP TS 26.245 5.17 (the text as stored); WebVTT 4.2.2 (cue text may start with spaces); docs/design/text.md choices 8 and 9 (text is kept as stored)

conditions.ffmpeg: cues whose text is empty or white space only

entries.basis: docs/design/text.md choice 8 (a sample with no text, or only white space, gives no cue)

conditions.source: each dropped cue an invalid sample of the source, by text and exact times, as many as there are

entries.basis: 3GPP TS 26.245 5.1 (UTF-8, or UTF-16 after a byte order mark); docs/design/text.md choice 8 (invalid sequences become U+FFFD and are counted; ffmpeg drops such samples)

conditions.source: QuickTime text sample entry (text) whose samples hold CR
conditions.cues: same count; CoreAV's text has a line break where ffmpeg's has none, and they are equal without line breaks
conditions.rewrite: CoreAV's cue text without those line breaks

entries.basis: 3GPP TS 26.245 5.11 (CR should be treated as a new line); docs/design/text.md choice 8

conditions.ffprobe: source packets without a duration, at least as many as such cues
conditions.ffmpeg: cues that end where they start
conditions.coreav: the same cue start, ending later
conditions.source: CoreAV's cue a sample's exact times from the source's sample tables or fragments' runs, rounded as CoreAV rounds

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.1.2 (sample durations); W3C WebVTT 4.1 (a cue ends after it starts); docs/design/text.md choice 7

conditions.source track: one media edit whose media time M is above 0
conditions.shift: from the source's stts: how far after M the first sample at or after M starts, in ms (above 0)
conditions.cues: same count; every CoreAV cue time = ffmpeg's plus the shift, to 1.5 ms as each side rounds its own times (the last end may be left to KD-T-LAST-END)

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6 (the edit's media time is the first media time presented); docs/design/text.md choice 7

conditions.cues: same count; only the last cue's end differs
conditions.ffmpeg: the last cue ends at the format duration ffprobe reports, to 1 ms
conditions.rewrite: ffmpeg's last end replaced by CoreAV's
conditions.source: CoreAV's last end the source's exact last end

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.1.2 (the last sample's duration is in the decoding time to sample box); docs/design/text.md choice 7

conditions.source track: a timescale that does not divide 1000, so milliseconds are not exact
conditions.cues: same count; times at most 1 ms apart, text equal
conditions.source: CoreAV's times a sample's exact times from the source's sample tables (or fragments) and edit, rounded as CoreAV rounds

entries.basis: docs/design/text.md choice 7 (times are the exact presentation times rounded to the nearest millisecond)

conditions.coreav: exit 1, an edit list outside the supported model
conditions.source track: a media edit whose rate is not 1

entries.basis: the edit model takes media edits at rate 1 only; docs/design/text.md choice 7

conditions.media bytes: a chpl box in moov/udta, and no enabled track names a text track in a chap reference

entries.basis: docs/design/text.md choice 6: Nero chpl is in neither Apple's QuickTime File Format, ISO/IEC 14496-12 nor the MP4RA registry

conditions.media bytes: an HMMT box in moov/udta, and no enabled track names a text track in a chap reference

entries.basis: docs/design/text.md: only QuickTime chapter tracks are read; HMMT (GoPro HiLight tags) is in no cited specification

conditions.media bytes: chap references (of any track) name two or more text tracks; CoreAV's chapters come from the first one an enabled track names
conditions.coreav: its titles are that track's sample texts, and (without an edit that moves them) its times are that track's stts times, both read from the sample tables
conditions.ffprobe: every chapter title is the text of a sample of one of those tracks, read from their sample tables

entries.basis: Apple QuickTime File Format, Chapter lists (QuickTime uses the first chapter list it finds); docs/design/text.md choice 5
